objectives: “The students should learn and understand the principle of international theories and policies. In addition, the ability to analyze the effects of international trade events is also required.“
content:
“1 Course introduction
2 The Ricardian model I, Beginning term test (期初考) LG 1(OBJ 1-1)
3 The Ricardian model II 1 Course introduction

2 The Ricardian model I, Beginning term test (期初考)

3 The Ricardian model II

4 The specific-factor model I

5 The specific-factor model II

6 The Hechscher-Ohlin model I

7 The Hechscher-Ohlin model II

8 Midterm Test (期中考)

9 Movement of labor and capital I

10 Movement of labor and capital II

11 Increasing returns to scale and monopolistic competition

12 Offshoring of goods and services

13 Import tariff and quota under perfect competition

14 Import tariff and quota under imperfect competition

15 Export subsidies

16 International agreements I

17 International agreements II

18 Final Test (期末考)“
books:
“Course Material
(課程教材) Krugman,P., M. Obstfeld, and M. J. Melitz (2022) International Economics: Theory and Policy, 12th ed.

Other Material
(其他參考書目)
新聞報導與報告

Final Test (期末考) 35％“
